messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=redwood-inference, deployment=release-2026-03-20, version=v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0, target traffic=10% -> 50% over 30m. Change window: 20:00-22:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/2026-03-20

maddie: ack. monitoring hooks sound good. Who's owning the canary watch?

raj: i'll watch latency + 5xx + hallucination evals. will post KPI updates every 5m.

kevin: quick ask — pin fallback to v2.1.0 ready if we need an instant rollback?

jenna: yes, pin job is ready: `POST /api/rollouts/pin` with body `{ "service": "redwood-inference", "version": "v2.1.0" }`. ops escalation if not auto rollback.

maddie: nice. thresholds: error_rate > 1.0% OR p95 latency delta > 25% OR hallucination regression on eval set -> hold and escalate.

deploy-bot: 5m progress: traffic shifted to 10%. KPIs: error_rate=0.27%, p95_latency=136ms (+4%), tokens/sec stable.

raj: seeing a small uptick in model soft-fails in reranker path, not user-facing yet. tagging @sara for product regression review.

sara: thanks — quick sanity check on a few prompts. so far minor rank flips, nothing catastrophic. hold if user-visible regression > 2% on eval queries.

deploy-bot: 15m progress: traffic shifted to 25%. KPIs: error_rate=0.45%, p95_latency=190ms (+40% vs baseline), tokens/sec -3%.

kevin: whoa p95 jumped. where is the latency coming from — infra or model?

ops-bot: alert: node group gpu-pool-3 reporting elevated host CPU steal + small KVM stalls in region eu-west-1. Correlated with rollout traffic start.

raj: looks like infra noise + longer decode tails on v2.2 for longer contexts. p95 spike mostly on >512 token requests.

maddie: agree we should not continue to 50% with p95 +40%. proposing to pause at 25% and pin traffic fraction at 25% while we triage. anyone oppose?

jenna: support pause. initiating pin to 25% and disabling auto-progress.

deploy-bot: Action: paused progressive rollout at 25%. Auto-progress disabled. Canary pinned to 25% traffic. Audit: https://internal.audit/rollouts/2041239876

kevin: next steps: 1) roll CPU steal mitigation with infra team, 2) test v2.2 decode path with long-context harness, 3) run quick A/B on shorter contexts to isolate. I'll take 1.

raj: i'll run targeted evals on the long-context set and share diffs in 10m.

sara: i'll loop in affected product owners and update customer-facing notes if we decide to rollback.

ops-bot: scheduled infra remediation: gpu-pool-3 reboot window 20:45-20:50 UTC. Ops oncall: kevin.

maddie: thanks all. if error_rate > 1.0% or p95 stays >30% delta after infra remediation, we do a full rollback to v2.1.0. jenna, be ready to execute pin->100%.

jenna: ready. pin->100% command queued, will execute on approval.

deploy-bot: thread closed for now. update here when triage complete or if you need to flip rollback. :white_check_mark:
